items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: The name 'Tink' appears only as a form of address by the [INTERVIEWER] (e.g., 'Which one was the leader, Tink?'). ctx.x: I know he went to a different name but Pujol. But his name was Palaszczuk. You see what I mean? Yeah. But we gave him the name of Pujol. I don't know how to call him, but that was it. Now, that was the men that really played in the high roles. Now, you had the...
Which one was the leader, Tink? Did you remember him? Bill Gallaty. Bill Gallaty.

Old man, not because he's got a son. We've got a Bill Gallaty plays now. Plays a trombone. Yeah, that's his son. Well, that's his son. He's worked with our band from time to time. Well, that's his son. Well, he's daddy. Because they used to own a dairy. He used to be a dairyman. He used to own a dairy. See? Well, that's all that I could think of.
